changelog:
pushes Ava beyond voice satellite into a complete home terminal. Six major features, deep subsystem fixes.

1. Software Acoustic Echo Cancellation. Ava subtracts its own playback from microphone input for reliable wake-word detection during music, TTS, or chimes. Path: Settings → Connectivity → Software Echo Cancellation. Off by default; toggles instantly. Auto-disables hardware AEC to prevent dual-filter conflict. Built-in speakers work best; Bluetooth speakers not recommended due to variable latency. SpeexDSP 1.2.1, 16 kHz mono, 20 ms frames, ~4 s reference buffer.

2. Voice Messages & LAN Intercom. Device-to-device voice messaging, persistent message board, real-time peer-to-peer calling across the LAN. No cloud, no accounts. Auto-discovery via UDP 19848, audio on 19849, Opus 32 kbps with in-band FEC. Path: Settings → Extensions → Voice Messages & Calls. Receive permission required; timeout controls prevent infinite channels.

3. Android Desktop Launcher. Set Ava as system Home app; Home key returns to Ava. Displays installed app icons for quick access. Path: Settings → Device Control → System Launcher. Dark mode available at Settings → Extensions → Interface. No live wallpaper support.

4. Sendspin Protocol Overhaul. Full Music Assistant LAN player upgrade. Manual FLAC/PCM/Opus switching, software vs device volume, sync offset slider (-1000 to +1000 ms), low-memory mode, copyable technical logs. Path: Settings → Extensions → Playback → Media Player.

5. VS Wake-Word Engine. Native Android inference pipeline, Android 7 through 16. Models shipped in release assets. Path: Settings → Voice Config → Wake Word Engine → On Device (vsWakeWord).

6. Customizable Home Header. Replace top-left title and subtitle with custom text. Title max 12 chars, subtitle max 20, live character count, instant apply. Path: Settings → Extensions → Interface → Customize Header Text.

Also: external broadcast permission control (Shizuku/root required), Bluetooth scan mode/power profile switching, tap-to-copy debug logs, Mod Store permission alias resolution, bottom-sheet device info swipe-up.

Fixed: microphone self-capture interfering with wake, hardware/software AEC conflict, Bluetooth proxy broadcast/discovery failure, scan state desync, screensaver WebView freeze/crash, software volume ineffectiveness, custom wake sound reverting on reboot, voice call resource leaks, Sendspin decoder state residue, unclear settings hierarchy, and extensive audio/Bluetooth/UI issues. Thanks @danwi, @inventor7777, and community testers.
